method: tools/measure_stored: each program loaded on the row machine, each named slider taken over and its control driven over 2..254 through the plugin's operator (pot readings on the panels, fader values on the LARC); the stored byte read from RAM once it held still (--still). Directions measured: down, up; variations measured: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 (a variation whose tables differ from variation 1 gets an override). Checked with --step sweeps: variations [2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8], 196224 sampled values, all as the tables say. Variation 1 swept at every fader value with --down --settle 0.005 --still 0.02 (SIZE, whose record byte is scratch while the firmware rebuilds, re-measured at --still 0.25 and listed as unmeasurable by --scratch-name '^SIZE'); every other variation checked at every 4th value (tools/measure_stored_variations.sh --step 4), and the sliders whose samples differed (PREDELAY: its clamp changes per variation) swept at every value.
